target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: This is a multi-center, open-label, dose escalation study to determine the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and maximum tolerated dose (MTD) of QBS10072S in patients with advanced or metastatic cancers with high LAT1 expression.

role_evidence.quote: QBS10072S targets cancers with high LAT1 expression.

flag.reason: High LAT1 is stated in title/summary for the advanced solid-tumour cohort but is not listed in the eligibility criteria and does not appear to apply to the grade 4 astrocytoma cohort; entry-requirement status unclear.

coder_notes: Basket phase 1 (solid tumours with high LAT1 plus relapsed/refractory grade 4 astrocytoma expansion). Glioblastoma counted via 'Grade 4 Astrocytoma' in the title without an IDH requirement (D27C historical terminology); GBM/Glioblastoma appear only in keywords. Single registered arm; the LAT1 requirement applies to the advanced/metastatic cohort only, which is not a separate registered arm, so biomarker arms left empty. PK is plasma only. Pharmacodynamics is a stated objective but no PD measure is described, hence target_engagement unclear.
